description: Lift a supplied simple polynomial root from modulo a prime to modulo a bounded prime power one p-adic digit at a time.

source.title: A Computational Introduction to Number Theory and Algebra, section 12.5.2, and FLINT Hensel lifting documentation
source.author: Victor Shoup; FLINT documentation contributors
source.reference: Shoup, version 2.0, section 12.5.2; FLINT algorithm documentation, Hensel's lemma/Newton iteration.
source.implementation_status: Clean-room bounded general-polynomial simple-root lift; algorithm descriptions only.

output.encoding: the unique integer root r in [0,prime^exponent) congruent to root_mod_prime modulo prime

contract.lift_step: Given r with f(r)=0 mod p^j, evaluate f(r) modulo p^(j+1), set q=(f(r) mod p^(j+1))/p^j, and append digit t=(-q*(f'(root_mod_prime))^-1) mod p by r <- r+t*p^j.
contract.uniqueness: The supplied root is simple because f'(root_mod_prime) is nonzero modulo prime; Hensel's lemma gives one lift in its residue class at every exponent.
contract.inverse: The inverse modulo p is found by trying candidates 1 through p-1; p is at most 43.
contract.arithmetic_bound: Every modulus is at most 100000. Horner products of reduced values are below 10^10; derivative and inverse products are below 43^2 or 4*1000*43, all safely within signed i64.
contract.invalid_cases: Null, malformed, nonprime p, modulus over 100000, out-of-range coefficients, non-root seed, or nonsimple seed return -1.
